title: lm_head optimization — decode fixed-cost intercept

fuse_argmax.effect: folds greedy argmax into lm_head GEMV epilogue; drops SoftCap+Argmax packets (542->540 decode)
fuse_argmax.gate: token stream + step-0 logits BYTE-IDENTICAL vs classic at ctx 1k/4k/16k (12B); argmax device==host AGREE

fp8_head.recipe: per-output-row scale = amax/448, torch.float8_e4m3fn (matches layer-twin recipe)
fp8_head.note: shipped twins omit fp8 embed/lm_head; head quantized here from bf16 embed

tpot_ms_mean_31b.note: decode-only prompt path (PLOW_PREFILL=0); 31B prefill object illegal-access at 79.75KB smem is a pre-existing harness issue (bf16 baseline fails too)

fuse_argmax_gate_31b.ctx1024: token stream + step-0 logits BYTE-IDENTICAL vs FP8 bf16-head; argmax AGREE

verdict: fp8 lm_head shrinks the fixed decode intercept by ~0.64ms (12B, -3.4% TPOT at ctx1k, biggest at short ctx); fused argmax is byte-identical but a wash for the intercept (lm_head is weight-bandwidth-bound; the logit round-trip it removes is ~0.1%).
